headline: Altria Considers Takeover Bid for Imperial Brands
summary: US tobacco company Altria is considering a takeover bid for UK rival Imperial Brands, causing shares in the British company to jump 13%.
why: Altria is a major US tobacco manufacturer, while Imperial Brands is a large UK-based tobacco company. Cross-border takeovers in the tobacco sector draw significant interest due to industry consolidation and cash-flow generation.

impacts.name: Imperial Brands
impacts.why: Shares jumped 13% following news of a potential takeover bid by US rival Altria.
